# Source snapshot

This directory contains the `main` source tree from
[Mintzz666/codex-usage-badge](https://github.com/Mintzz666/codex-usage-badge)
at commit `d014efcd7735a4349576c6b424cac23b614f9115` (2026-09-30).

The project originates from
[jaykinhoo9/codex-usage-badge](https://github.com/jaykinhoo9/codex-usage-badge)
and remains under the MIT License. The customized macOS runtime currently
shipped by Codex Monitor is pinned separately under
`Resources/CodexUsageBadge/`; this directory is the complete fork source tree.
